name: primeopp-product-enrichment
purpose: Resolve and enrich sparse product intake data into a normalized evidence-backed product profile.

externalProviders.description: Deterministic local provider backed by JSON fixtures in /fixtures.
Converts manual user input into provider-style evidence.
Reusable HTTP adapter template. Disabled by default; hosts must supply requestBuilder, responseMapper, and credentials.
Book metadata adapter boundary. Requires host-supplied IsbnMetadataSource.

optionalSecrets.name: PRIMEOPP_ENRICH_HTTP_PROVIDER_API_KEY
optionalSecrets.purpose: API key for the GenericHttpProductProvider when wired to a real product-data API. Loaded by the host and passed via HttpProviderConfig.apiKey — never read from process.env by the core module.

verifiedCapabilities: ISBN_LOOKUP via FixtureProductProvider and IsbnProductProvider with mock IsbnMetadataSource
IMAGE_DISCOVERY via all providers (URLs only, no bytes downloaded)
CATEGORY_RESOLUTION via fixture and ISBN providers
Provider failure isolation (one failure does not crash the run)
Provider short-circuit on confidence threshold (SEQUENTIAL mode)
In-memory cache (deterministic keys, TTL, LRU-like eviction)
Image URL deduplication and primary selection
Attribute normalization (brand, title, model, color, size, dimensions, weight)
Structured error codes for all failure modes
mockedCapabilities: GenericHttpProductProvider live HTTP integration (mocked via fetchImpl in tests; disabled in production by default)
IsbnMetadataSource live integration (mocked via FakeIsbnSource in tests)

integrationDependencies.name: primeopp-product-intake
integrationDependencies.purpose: Prior pipeline module that produces ProductEnrichmentInput. This module recreates the minimum shared contract; no source-code dependency.

integrationDependencies.name: primeopp-marketplace-comps
integrationDependencies.purpose: Downstream pipeline module that consumes EnrichedProductProfile (via CompsRequest adapter). Not yet implemented; boundary contract defined in examples/downstream-handoff.ts.

integrationDependencies.name: Host-supplied cache adapter
integrationDependencies.purpose: Optional. When the host needs distributed caching, it must implement ProductEnrichmentCache (e.g. Redis-backed). InMemoryEnrichmentCache is the default.

integrationDependencies.name: Host-supplied IsbnMetadataSource
integrationDependencies.purpose: Required only when IsbnProductProvider is registered. Host must implement IsbnMetadataSource against Open Library, Google Books, ISBNdb, or its own book metadata backend.

integrationDependencies.name: Host-supplied HTTP request/response mappers
integrationDependencies.purpose: Required only when GenericHttpProductProvider is enabled. Host must supply requestBuilder and responseMapper functions specific to the chosen product-data API (UPCitemdb, Barcode Lookup, Open Food Facts, internal PIM, etc.).

cleanRoomNotes: Built without access to the real PrimeOpp codebase. All contracts are explicitly defined and isolated. All live integrations are adapter templates; fixture-backed providers are fully verified.
